name: Vol-of-vol shock fade — RSI-washout confirmation (4h)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (the 4h vol-of-vol fade, confirming the panic with an RSI washout instead of a raw return leg so the fade only fires on a genuinely oversold dip, a different crowding gauge): a sharp UP-repricing of dvol is the options market pricing convexity faster than spot warrants; VOV spikes are the most transient part of the surface (Du 2025, JFM) and revert because the repricing overshoots the real information. We proxy the shock by dvol above a fitted level WHILE realized has not yet expanded (vol_realized below a fitted ceiling — implied racing ahead) AND rsi in washout territory (the panic already dumped price into oversold). The counterparty is gamma-scalping desks mechanically bidding vol-of-vol during the shock — forced buyers at the wrong price we fade with a spot long. Distinct from dvol-spike-capitulation (LEVEL extreme): here a mid-level dvol fires if implied outruns a calm realized and price is washed out. Exit: rsi crosses up out of oversold (the fade has paid) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: swap the implied-ahead-of-realized leg for a dvol LEVEL threshold only — if the static level matches, the VOV thesis is unsupported and this is a dvol-spike re-skin. DISCONFIRMER 2: if the RSI washout alone (drop both vol legs) matches the deflated Sharpe, this is a plain oversold dip-buy, not a vol-family edge. HARD CAVEAT: ~148 DVOL points -> paper-only.
catalyst: implied vol overshoot into an RSI washout — a vol-of-vol panic to fade
